description:
List every engagement Fidget Labs offers: the situation it answers, what it includes,
the outcome, how it is contracted and who leads it. The same list as
https://fidgetlabs.io/how-we-engage. There are no prices or durations: every engagement
is scoped to the client (engagement: "scoped"). For cost, point people to /contact.

Use this when someone asks what Fidget Labs offers, or which engagement fits a stalled
program, an AI cost question, or a platform choice.

limit.description: Offers to return, 1 to 50. Omit it for all of them.
